h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Surat

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Surat

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Surat

c: Surat is only about 200 km up the coast from our factory in Vasai, which makes it one of the closest large cities we supply. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Surat for housing societies, schools, colleges, corporate campuses and municipal gardens. The diamond and textile trades have filled the city with large residential complexes, and many of them now want an open gym beside the garden or the jogging track.

Surat is humid for much of the year and gets heavy monsoon rain, with the Tapi running through the city. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for that kind of weather. We suggest machines from photos and site measurements, send a layout drawing with the clear space marked, and install with our own team or a dealer in western India.

richText.heading: An open gym for a large housing society

c: In a big society, the gym is used by every age group. Combine strength machines for younger residents with gentler ones for seniors. The
lets three older residents exercise together.

Societies near the river or on low ground should raise the gym pad and drain it well before the monsoon. Rubber flooring under the stations keeps the footing firm when wet. Since Surat is close to Vasai, adding machines in a second phase is simple to arrange. For the play area, see our

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 200 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How many machines does a Surat housing society usually need?
items.a: It depends on the number of flats and the space. Many societies start with six to eight stations and add more later. We will suggest a set after seeing your layout.

items.q: Is the equipment suitable for Surat's humid weather?
items.a: Yes. The frames are galvanised and the seats and handles are roto-moulded, so they resist rust in humid air and heavy rain. Wipe them down after long wet spells.

items.q: Can a builder include the gym in a new project?
items.a: Yes. We work with builders to plan the gym alongside the garden and play area, and install it before handover. Send us the site plan to start.
